## Objective
For the paper Artificial intelligence in veterinary diagnostic histopathology: a scoping review and survey of current implementation 

Analyze 
1) How the volume of research on AI applications in veterinary diagnostic histopathology has changed over time.
2) How the types of AI applications have evolved, including intended use. AI model types, data sources, learning methodologies, and methods for addressing explainability.

### Input
Records identified in lit search.Rmd, and manually reviewed 


#Reviewed reports - parsed for supplementary table S2
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
reviewed_reports_raw <- read_xlsx( "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/artificial_intelligence_in_veterinary_diagnostic_histopathology_a_scoping_review_and_survey_of_current_implementation//input/reviewed_reports/supplementary_table_s2_reviewed_articles_ai_dx_bx_vet_v12.xlsx")

reviewed_reports_parsed <- reviewed_reports_raw %>%
  rename(Author = author) %>%
  mutate(Purpose = case_when(
    intended_use == "count_mitoses" ~ "Mitotic count",
    intended_use == "diagnosis" ~ "Lesion classification",
    intended_use == "count_Ki67" ~ "Ki67 count",
    intended_use == "quantification_area_necrosis" ~ "Quantification, necrosis",
    intended_use == "genotype_prediction"  ~ "Genotype prediction",
    intended_use == "morphometry_nuclei" ~ "Nuclear morphometry",
    intended_use == "clonality_prediction ihc_prediction diagnosis" ~ "Clonality prediction",
    intended_use == "count_lymphocytes" ~ "Lymphocyte count",
    intended_use == "synthetic_image_generation" ~ "Synthetic image generation",
    intended_use == "virtual_ihc" ~ "Virtual IHC",
    intended_use == "prognostication" ~ "Response to treatment prediction",
    intended_use == "quantification_area_fibrosis" ~ "Quantification, fibrosis",
    TRUE ~ intended_use)) %>%
   mutate(Disease = case_when(
     (species == "dog" & disease == "mast_cell_tumors") |
       (species == "dog" & disease == "mast_cell_tumor") 
     ~ "Canine MCT",
     species == "dog" & disease == "mammary_tumors" 
     ~ "Canine mammary tumors",
     species == "dog human" & disease == "mammary_tumors" ~ "Canine & human mammary tumors",  
     species == "dog" & disease == "fibrosarcoma" 
     ~ "Canine fibrosarcoma",
     species == "dog" & disease == "cutaneous_round_cell_tumors" 
     ~ "Canine round cell tumors",
     species == "dog" & disease == "perivascular_wall_tumor" 
     ~ "Canine PWT",
     species == "dog" & disease == "skin_tumors" 
     ~ "Canine skin tumors",
     species == "dog" & disease == "soft_tissue_sarcoma" 
     ~ "Canine STS",
     species == "dog" & disease == "mast_cell_tumor mammary_tumors" 
     ~ "Canine MCT & mammary tumors",
     species == "dog" & disease == "lymphoma" 
     ~ "Canine lymphoma",
     species == "dog" & disease == "urothelial_carcinoma" 
     ~ "Canine urothelial carcinoma",
     species == "dog cat" & disease == "lymphoma" 
     ~ "Canine & feline lymphoma",
     species == "cat" & disease == "t_cell_lymphoma" ~ "Feline T-cell lymphoma",
     species == "cat" & disease == "fce" 
     ~ "Feline chronic enteropathy",
     species == "dog cat" & disease == "mast_cell_tumor soft_tissue_sarcoma" 
     ~ "Canine & feline MCT & STS",
     species == "dog" & disease == "PLE" 
     ~ "Canine PLE",
     species == "dog cat human" & disease == "cancer_multiple" 
     ~ "Canine, feline & human neoplasia",
     species == "dog" & disease == "pulmonary_carcinoma" 
     ~ "Canine pulmonary carcinoma",
     species == "horse" & disease == "endometritis"
     ~ "Equine endometritis")) %>%
  mutate(Task = case_when(
    (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "object (mitoses)") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "object (cells)") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "pixel object (nuclei)") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "pixel object (lymphocytes)") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "object (mitoses) or pixel or patch") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "object_and _pixels  (nuclei)")
    ~ "Object classification",
    (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "image") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "image (patch)") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "patch") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "patches") | 
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "image (tile)")
      ~ "Image classification",
    (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "pixel patch") | 
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "pixel") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "pixel image") |
      (task_type == "classification" & classification_level == "pixels (nuclei)") 
    ~ "Pixel classification",
    task_type == "image_to_image_translation" ~ "Image to image translation",
    task_type == "image_generation" ~ "Image generation")) %>%
mutate(Model = case_when(
  model_type == "DL" & model_architecture == "CNN" 
  ~ "DL (CNN)",
  model_type == "classic_ML" & model_architecture == "SVM" 
  ~ "Classic ML (SVM)",
  model_type == "DL classic_ML" & model_architecture == "CNN SVM SGB" 
  ~ "DL (CNN) & classic ML (multiple)",
  model_type == "classic_ML" & model_architecture == "LDA SVM NB DT KNN" 
  ~ "Classic ML (multiple)",
  model_type == "DL" & model_architecture == "diffusion_model" 
  ~ "DL (diffusion model)",
  model_type == "DL" & model_architecture == "GAN" 
  ~ "DL (GAN)",
  model_type == "DL" & model_architecture == "ViT CNN" 
  ~ "DL (ViT & CNN)",
  TRUE ~ "Not reported")) %>%
  mutate(Learning = case_when(
    learning_paradigm == "supervised" ~ "Supervised",
    learning_paradigm == "weakly_supervised" ~ "Weakly supervised",
    learning_paradigm == "self_supervised" ~ "Self-supervised"
  )) %>%
  mutate(Target = case_when(
    target_source == "human_annotation" ~ "Annotations",
    target_source == "human_annotation_ihc_assisted" ~ "Annotations",
    target_source == "genotype" ~ "Genotype",
    target_source == "human_annotation clonality ihc" ~ "Clonality",
    target_source == "ihc" ~ "IHC",
    target_source == "medical_record_data" ~ "Medical record data",
    TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  mutate(MIL = case_when(
    mil_methodology == "bag-level label based on majority" ~ "Majority label",
    mil_methodology == "attention-based" ~ "Attention-based",
    TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  mutate(XAI = case_when(
    explainability_approach == "saliency_maps" ~ "Saliency map",
    TRUE ~ NA
  ))

supplementary_table <- reviewed_reports_parsed %>%
  select(Author, title, Purpose, Disease, Task, Model, Learning, Target, MIL, XAI)
    
write_xlsx(supplementary_table, "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/artificial_intelligence_in_veterinary_diagnostic_histopathology_a_scoping_review_and_survey_of_current_implementation/output/analyze_vet_papers/supplementary_table_s2.xlsx")     
     
    


```

## Reviewed reports - updated variable names
```{r}
library(jsonlite)
library(readxl)
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)

reviewed_reports <- read_xlsx( "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/artificial_intelligence_in_veterinary_diagnostic_histopathology_a_scoping_review_and_survey_of_current_implementation//input/reviewed_lit_search/reviewed_reports//reviewed_articles_ai_dx_bx_vet_v12_updated.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(pubmed_id == "24153030", as.numeric("2013"), year)) %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(is.na(year), year(as.Date(coverDate, format = "%Y-%m-%d")), year)) %>%
  mutate(year = ifelse(scopus_id == "105003396981", as.numeric("2025"), year)) %>%
  mutate(cancer = ifelse(
    disease == "pulmonary_carcinoma" |
      disease == "cancer_multiple" |
      disease == "perivascular_wall_tumor" |
      disease == "mast_cell_tumor soft_tissue_sarcoma" |
      disease == "mast_cell_tumor" |
      disease == "mast_cell_tumor mammary_tumors" |
      disease == "lymphoma" |
      disease == "t_cell_lymphoma" |
      disease == "mammary_tumors" |
      disease == "skin_tumors" |
      disease == "urothelial_carcinoma" |
      disease == "soft_tissue_sarcoma" |
      disease == "cutaneous_mast_cell_tumor mammary_tumors" |
      disease == "cutaneous_round_cell_tumors" |
      disease == "fibrosarcoma" |
      disease == "mast_cell_tumors", 
    TRUE, FALSE)) %>%
  mutate(application_type = case_when(
    grepl("count", intended_use) ~ "Cell count",
    grepl("morphometry", intended_use) ~ "Cell feature quantification",
    grepl("quantification_area", intended_use) ~ "Area quantification",
    grepl ("prediction", intended_use) ~ "Biomarker prediction",
    grepl ("virtual_ihc", intended_use) ~ "Virtual immunohistochemistry",
    grepl ("synthetic_image_generation", intended_use) ~ "Synthetic image generation",
    grepl("prognostication", intended_use) ~ "Response to treatment prediction",
    grepl("diagnosis", intended_use) ~ "Lesion classification",
    TRUE ~ NA
  )) %>%
  mutate(learning_paradigm = case_when(learning_paradigm == "supervised" ~ "Supervised learning",
                                       learning_paradigm == "weakly_supervised" ~ "Weakly supervised learning",
                                       learning_paradigm == "self_supervised" ~ "Self-supervised learning",
                                       TRUE ~ NA)) %>%
  mutate(model_type_and_architecture = case_when(model_architecture == "CNN" ~ "DL (CNN)",
                                       model_architecture == "CNN SVM SGB" ~ "DL (CNN) and classic ML (multiple)",
                                       model_architecture == "SVM" ~ "Classic ML (SVM)",
                                       model_architecture == "LDA SVM NB DT KNN" ~ "Classic ML (multiple)",
                                       model_architecture == "ViT CNN" ~ "DL (CNN and ViT)",
                                       model_architecture == "diffusion_model" ~ "DL (diffusion model)",
                                        model_architecture == "GAN" ~ "DL (GAN)",
                                       TRUE ~ NA))
  

intended_use_summary <- reviewed_reports %>%
  count(application_type, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percentage))

print(intended_use_summary)

#write_json(intended_use_summary, paste0(output_dir, "intended_use_summary.json"), pretty =TRUE)


  
# Count publications by year & type
application_type_counts_by_year <- reviewed_reports %>%
  count(year, application_type)

# Compute overall order (largest total count → first level)
application_type_order <- c( "Cell count", "Area quantification", "Cell feature quantification", "Lesion classification","Biomarker prediction" , "Response to treatment prediction",  "Virtual immunohistochemistry" ,  "Synthetic image generation")

application_type_palette <- c(
  "Area quantification" = "#deebf7",
  "Cell feature quantification"= "#9ecae1",
  "Cell count" = "#3182bd",
  "Lesion classification" = "#bae4b3",
  "Biomarker prediction" = "#e6550d",
  "Response to treatment prediction" = "#fd8d3c",
  "Virtual immunohistochemistry" = "#feedde",
  "Synthetic image generation" = "#fdbe85")

# 3. Apply that ordering to the factor
application_type_counts_by_year <- application_type_counts_by_year %>%
  mutate(application_type = factor(application_type,
                                   levels = application_type_order))

# Get full range of years
full_years <- seq(min(application_type_counts_by_year$year),
                  max(application_type_counts_by_year$year))

# Expand grid to get all combinations of year and application_type
all_combinations <- expand_grid(
  year = full_years,
  application_type = unique(application_type_counts_by_year$application_type)
)

# Join to original data and fill in missing values with 0
application_type_counts_by_year <- all_combinations %>%
  left_join(application_type_counts_by_year, by = c("year", "application_type")) %>%
  mutate(n = replace_na(n, 0))

plot <- ggplot(application_type_counts_by_year,
       aes(x = factor(year),
           y = n,
           fill = application_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = application_type_palette,
    breaks = application_type_order
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 12),
    breaks = 0:12
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    drop = FALSE  # ensures all factor levels are shown
  ) +
  labs(
    x     = "Year",
    y     = "Number of publications",
    fill  = "Intended use"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank()
  )

print(plot)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot)
plot_nolegend <- plot + theme(legend.position = "none")

combined <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  plot_nolegend,
  cowplot::ggdraw(legend),
  nrow = 1,
  rel_widths = c(4.25, 2.75)
)

ggsave(
  filename = "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/artificial_intelligence_in_veterinary_diagnostic_histopathology_a_scoping_review_and_survey_of_current_implementation/paper/figures/fig_7_results/intended_use.png",
  plot = combined,    # Optional if it's the last plot drawn
  width = 7,
  height = 2.33,
  dpi = 300,
  units = "in"
)
```
